content.text:
**答案：Lavodayapura（ละโวทยปุระ，意思是“Lava 起源之城”）。** 英文维基百科《History of Lopburi》写道：“In the 10th century, when it was known as Lavodayapura (Khmer language), Lavo was subordinate to the Khmer empire.”

另外两处来源：
- 暹罗学会（Siam Society）期刊里 Griswold 和 Prasert 的论文说，吴哥圣剑寺（Prah Khan of Angkor）的碑铭称这座城为 Lavodayapura。
- 法文的博士论文（Roche 2023）里，这座城也写作 Lavodaya。

依据网址：
- https://browse.library.kiwix.org/content/wikipedia_en_all_maxi/A/History_of_Lopburi
- https://kids.kiddle.co/History_of_Lopburi
- https://thesiamsociety.org/wp-content/uploads/1972/03/JSS_060_1c_GriswoldPrasert_KingLodaiyaOfSukhodayaAndContemporaries.pdf

**答案：Lavodayapura（ละโวทยปุระ，意思是“Lava 起源之城”）。** 英文维基百科《History of Lopburi》写道：“In the 10th century, when it was known as Lavodayapura (Khmer language), Lavo was subordinate to the Khmer empire.”

另外两处来源：
- 暹罗学会（Siam Society）期刊里 Griswold 和 Prasert 的论文说，吴哥圣剑寺（Prah Khan of Angkor）的碑铭称这座城为 Lavodayapura。
- 法文的博士论文（Roche 2023）里，这座城也写作 Lavodaya。
